apple.subtitle: Field Performance & Training
apple.promotionalText: Private field tools, training, progress and trusted-device access for authorized Paradise Exteriors team members.
apple.description:
Paradise Performance is a private workforce application for authorized Paradise Exteriors team members. It brings field tools, training, progress, trusted-device access and active-workday functions into one controlled mobile experience.

Authorized employees can access company training and progress resources, use approved field workflows and start an active workday when their role requires it. Certain field functions may use device location during an employee-started active workday to support operational route and workday records. Location is not intended to begin merely because the app is opened.

Access is restricted to authorized Paradise personnel. Installing the app does not create an employee account or grant access by itself. Device enrollment and session controls remain part of the authorization boundary.

Paradise Performance is intended for company workforce use and is not a consumer sales, shopping or public canvassing application.
apple.reviewNotes:
Paradise Performance is an employee-only workforce application intended for unlisted App Store distribution. Please do not treat the app as a public consumer product. Access to protected functions requires an authorized employee account and trusted-device enrollment.

Location behavior: the employee intentionally starts the active-workday flow from the foreground. The app requests When In Use location permission for this work function and may continue location updates while that employee-started workday is active and the app is backgrounded. The native implementation enables the visible iOS background-location indicator. Ordinary app launch is not intended to begin workday location tracking.

The app uses location for field/workday operational functionality, not advertising or cross-company tracking.

REVIEW ACCESS BLOCKER: final App Review test account/enrollment instructions must be inserted here before submission. Do not submit while this blocker remains.
apple.unlistedRequest: Paradise Performance is designed for a limited workforce audience: authorized Paradise Exteriors employees, canvassers, managers and other company-approved personnel. The app is not intended for consumer discovery or general public use. Paradise needs a standard App Store link that can be sent directly to authorized team members using company-managed or employee-owned iPhones. The app itself enforces employee authorization and trusted-device controls, so possession of the download link alone does not grant access. Unlisted distribution is requested so authorized personnel can install and receive normal App Store updates without making this internal workforce tool searchable or promoted to the general public.
apple.unlistedRequestSequence: Submit the final app to App Review with Review Notes stating that unlisted distribution is intended, then submit Apple's unlisted-app request. Do not represent a beta/prerelease build as eligible for the unlisted request.

dataCollected: Other Data Types / operational shift and workday evidence
privacyDraft.taxonomyNote: Do not declare Product Interaction solely for employee workday events. Apple defines Product Interaction as app-interaction telemetry such as launches, taps, clicks, scrolling and views. The current native store runtime retains operational shift/workday evidence rather than general UI-interaction analytics; classify that residual operational evidence under Other Data Types unless the final binary adds separately retained interaction telemetry.

googlePlay.shortDescription: Private field performance, training and workday tools for Paradise employees.
googlePlay.fullDescription:
Paradise Performance is a private workforce application for authorized Paradise Exteriors team members. It combines field tools, employee training, progress resources, trusted-device access and active-workday functions in one controlled mobile app.

Authorized employees can use approved field workflows and start an active workday when their role requires it. During an employee-started active workday, the Android app can use location through a visible foreground location service to support operational route and workday records. The controlled app does not request Android ACCESS_BACKGROUND_LOCATION.

Access is restricted to authorized Paradise personnel. Installing the app does not create an account or automatically grant company access.

This application is intended for Paradise workforce use and is not a public consumer application.

foregroundServiceDeclaration.functionalityDescription: An authorized employee starts the active-workday function from the foreground. While that workday is active, Paradise Performance uses a visible location foreground service to maintain operational route/workday location evidence even if the app is temporarily backgrounded.
foregroundServiceDeclaration.userImpactIfDeferred: The active workday could begin without timely route/location evidence, causing gaps in operational field records and reducing reliability of workday synchronization.
foregroundServiceDeclaration.userImpactIfInterrupted: Location evidence for the active workday could contain gaps until the service resumes, which may reduce the completeness of the employee's operational route/workday record.
foregroundServiceDeclaration.useCase: Employee-started long-running location sharing / operational field-work tracking

dataSafetyDraft.currentTrackNote: Google Play states that apps exclusively active on Internal Testing are exempt from inclusion in the Data Safety section. Preserve this draft for any later distribution mode where Google requires Data Safety answers; do not treat it as a blocker to the initial Internal Testing release solely on Data Safety grounds.
dataCollected: App activity > Other actions / employee-started workday actions where retained
dataSafetyDraft.taxonomyNote: Google defines App activity > Other actions as other in-app user activity/actions that do not fit the listed subcategories. Use that category for retained employee Start/Finish workday actions; do not imply general app-interaction analytics unless the final binary actually collects them.
